q: My sister ___ to work by bus every day.
e: every day 表示習慣，用現在簡單式；主詞 My sister 是第三人稱單數，動詞加 -es。

q: We ___ dinner when the phone rang.
e: 電話響的那一刻，晚餐正在進行，用過去進行式 were having。

q: The meeting starts ___ 9 o'clock.
e: 幾點幾分用 at；星期、日期用 on；月份、年份用 in。

q: I was born ___ July.
e: 月份前用 in。

q: She speaks English very ___.
e: 修飾動詞 speaks 要用副詞 well；good 是形容詞。

q: There ___ two apples on the table.
e: There be 句型看後面的名詞，two apples 是複數，用 are。

q: This bag is ___ than that one.
e: 有 than 用比較級；heavy 字尾 y 改 i 加 -er。

q: I wanted to go out, ___ it was raining.
e: 想出門和下雨是相反的情況，用 but。

q: This is not my umbrella. It's ___.
e: 句尾單獨使用、代替 her umbrella 的是所有格代名詞 hers。

q: The new bridge ___ last year.
e: 橋是被建造的，又發生在 last year，用過去式被動 was built。

q: I ___ in Keelung since 2015.
e: since 加上過去時間點，表示從那時到現在，用現在完成式。

q: ___ the heavy rain, the game continued.
e: 後面接名詞片語 the heavy rain，用介系詞 Despite；Although 後面要接完整子句。

q: ___ it was late, we kept working.
e: 後面是子句 it was late，要用連接詞 Although。

q: Each of the students ___ a laptop.
e: Each of + 複數名詞，主詞是 each，視為單數，用 has。

q: The hotel staff were very ___ to us.
e: be 動詞後面接形容詞當補語，helpful 是形容詞。

q: If it ___ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
e: 對未來可能發生的事作真實條件句，if 子句用現在式代替未來式。

q: I'm looking forward to ___ you soon.
e: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接動名詞 seeing。

q: The woman ___ called you is my manager.
e: 先行詞是人，在子句中當主詞，用 who。

q: He decided ___ his job.
e: decide 後面接不定詞 to + 原形動詞。

q: If I ___ more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
e: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句用過去式 had，主要子句用 would + 原形。

q: If she had left earlier, she ___ the train.
e: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用過去完成式，主要子句用 would have + 過去分詞。

q: Neither the manager nor the employees ___ aware of the change.
e: neither A nor B 的動詞跟著靠近的 B，the employees 是複數，用 were。

q: The news was very ___.
e: 事物令人感到驚訝用 -ing；人感到驚訝才用 -ed。

q: This is the town ___ I grew up.
e: 先行詞是地點，在子句中表示「在那裡」，用關係副詞 where（= in which）。

q: The report must ___ by Friday.
e: 報告是被完成的；助動詞 must 後接 be + 過去分詞。

q: The company has grown ___ over the past five years.
e: 修飾動詞 has grown 要用副詞 significantly。

q: You can't enter the building ___ you have an ID card.
e: unless = if not，「除非你有證件，否則不能進入」。

q: By the time we arrived, the movie ___.
e: 兩件過去的事，先發生的電影開演用過去完成式 had started。

q: Please submit your expense reports no later ___ Friday.
e: no later than 是固定用法，意思是「不晚於」。

q: Ms. Lin was praised for her ___ approach to solving customer complaints.
e: 空格在所有格 her 與名詞 approach 之間，要用形容詞 creative。

q: All employees must complete the safety training ___ the end of the month.
e: by 表示「在某時間點之前完成」；until 表示「持續到某時」，和 complete 的語意不合。

q: The shipment ___ to the wrong address last week.
e: 貨物是被寄送的，時間是 last week，用過去式被動。

q: The number of applicants ___ increased this year.
e: The number of 的主詞是 number，用單數 has；a number of 才當複數。

q: ___ its high price, the new model sold out within a week.
e: 後面接名詞片語 its high price，只能用介系詞 Despite。

q: ___ the client called earlier, we could have fixed the problem.
e: If the client had called 省略 if 後倒裝成 Had the client called，表示與過去事實相反。

q: ___ you have any questions, please contact our customer service team.
e: If you should have 省略 if 倒裝成 Should you have，商業書信常見的委婉說法。

q: Mr. Chen prefers to review the contracts ___ before signing them.
e: 強調「親自」審閱，用反身代名詞 himself。

q: The manager asked for a ___ of the sales figures.
e: 冠詞 a 後面接名詞 summary。

q: The seminar was canceled ___ the speaker became ill.
e: 後面是子句 the speaker became ill，用連接詞 because；because of、due to 後面接名詞。

q: Not only ___ the deadline, but he also exceeded expectations.
e: 否定副詞 Not only 放句首要倒裝：助動詞 did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

q: It is essential that every participant ___ the consent form.
e: essential、necessary 等表示必要的字後接 that 子句，用原形動詞（省略 should）。

q: ___ by the results, the researchers repeated the experiment.
e: 研究人員是「被結果嚇到」，被動意義的分詞構句用過去分詞 Surprised。

q: The theory, ___ was first proposed in 1905, is still debated today.
e: 非限定關係子句（有逗號）不能用 that，指事物用 which。

q: The results of the study, along with the raw data, ___ available online.
e: along with 引導的插入語不影響主詞，主詞是 The results（複數），用 are。

q: Rarely ___ such a rapid change in global temperatures.
e: 否定副詞 Rarely 放句首，主詞與助動詞倒裝：have scientists observed。

q: The professor's argument was ___ supported by empirical evidence.
e: 修飾過去分詞 supported 要用副詞 strongly。

q: Had the policy been implemented sooner, the crisis ___.
e: Had... 倒裝表示與過去事實相反，主要子句用 could have been + 過去分詞。

q: ___ the evidence is limited, the findings should be interpreted with caution.
e: 後面接子句；Given that 是連接詞片語，意思是「考慮到」。其他三個後面只能接名詞。
